verses.en: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
verses.pt: Aquele que vive isolado busca seu próprio desejo; insurge-se contra a verdadeira sabedoria.
verses.en_web: An unfriendly man pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
verses.en_bbe: He who keeps himself separate for his private purpose goes against all good sense.

verses.en: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
verses.pt: O tolo não toma prazer no entendimento, mas tão somente em revelar a sua opinião.
verses.en_web: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
verses.en_bbe: A foolish man has no pleasure in good sense, but only to let what is in his heart come to light.

verses.en: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
verses.pt: Quando vem o ímpio, vem também o desprezo; e com a desonra vem o opróbrio.
verses.en_web: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
verses.en_bbe: When the evil-doer comes, a low opinion comes with him, and with the loss of honour comes shame.

verses.en: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
verses.pt: Aguas profundas são as palavras da boca do homem; e a fonte da sabedoria é um ribeiro que corre.
verses.en_web: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
verses.en_bbe: The words of a man's mouth are like deep waters: the fountain of wisdom is like a flowing stream.

verses.en: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.pt: Não é bom ter respeito à pessoa do impio, nem privar o justo do seu direito.
verses.en_web: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
verses.en_bbe: To have respect for the person of the evil-doer is not good, or to give a wrong decision against the upright.

verses.en: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
verses.pt: Os lábios do tolo entram em contendas, e a sua boca clama por açoites.
verses.en_web: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
verses.en_bbe: A foolish man's lips are a cause of fighting, and his mouth makes him open to blows.

verses.en: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.pt: A boca do tolo é a sua própria destruição, e os seus lábios um laço para a sua alma.
verses.en_web: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
verses.en_bbe: The mouth of a foolish man is his destruction, and his lips are a net for his soul.

verses.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.pt: As palavras do difamador são como bocados doces, que penetram até o íntimo das entranhas.
verses.en_web: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
verses.en_bbe: The words of one who says evil of his neighbour secretly are like sweet food, and go down into the inner parts of the stomach.

verses.en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
verses.pt: Aquele que é remisso na sua obra é irmão do que é destruidor.
verses.en_web: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
verses.en_bbe: He who does not give his mind to his work is brother to him who makes destruction.

verses.en: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.pt: Torre forte é o nome do Senhor; para ela corre o justo, e está seguro.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
verses.en_bbe: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the upright man running into it is safe.

verses.en: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
verses.pt: Os bens do rico são a sua cidade forte, e como um muro alto na sua imaginação.
verses.en_web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
verses.en_bbe: The property of a man of wealth is his strong town, and it is as a high wall in the thoughts of his heart.

verses.en: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
verses.pt: Antes da ruína eleva-se o coração do homem; e adiante da honra vai a humildade.
verses.en_web: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
verses.en_bbe: Before destruction the heart of man is full of pride, and before honour goes a gentle spirit.

verses.en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verses.pt: Responder antes de ouvir, é estultícia e vergonha.
verses.en_web: He who gives answer before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
verses.en_bbe: To give an answer before hearing is a foolish thing and a cause of shame.

verses.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
verses.pt: O espírito do homem o sustentará na sua enfermidade; mas ao espírito abatido quem o levantará?
verses.en_web: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
verses.en_bbe: The spirit of a man will be his support when he is ill; but how may a broken spirit be lifted up?

verses.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.pt: O coração do entendido adquire conhecimento; e o ouvido dos sábios busca conhecimento;
verses.en_web: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: The heart of the man of good sense gets knowledge; the ear of the wise is searching for knowledge.

verses.en: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
verses.pt: O presente do homem alarga-lhe o caminho, e leva-o à presença dos grandes.
verses.en_web: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
verses.en_bbe: A man's offering makes room for him, letting him come before great men.

verses.en: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
verses.pt: O que primeiro começa o seu pleito parece justo; até que vem o outro e o examina.
verses.en_web: He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him.
verses.en_bbe: The man who first puts his cause before the judge seems to be in the right; but then his neighbour comes and puts his cause in its true light.

verses.en: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
verses.pt: A sorte faz cessar os pleitos, e decide entre os poderosos.
verses.en_web: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
verses.en_bbe: The decision of chance puts an end to argument, parting the strong.

verses.en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.pt: um irmão ajudado pelo irmão é como uma cidade fortificada; é forte como os ferrolhos dum castelo.
verses.en_web: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city; and disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
verses.en_bbe: A brother wounded is like a strong town, and violent acts are like a locked tower.

verses.en: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.pt: O homem se fartará do fruto da sua boca; dos renovos dos seus lábios se fartará.
verses.en_web: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
verses.en_bbe: With the fruit of a man's mouth his stomach will be full; the produce of his lips will be his in full measure.

verses.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.pt: A morte e a vida estão no poder da língua; e aquele que a ama comerá do seu fruto.
verses.en_web: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.en_bbe: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; and those to whom it is dear will have its fruit for their food.

verses.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
verses.pt: Quem encontra uma esposa acha uma coisa boa; e alcança o favor do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Whoever gets a wife gets a good thing, and has the approval of the Lord.

verses.en: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
verses.pt: O pobre fala com rogos; mas o rico responde com durezas.
verses.en_web: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
verses.en_bbe: The poor man makes requests for grace, but the man of wealth gives a rough answer.

verses.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.pt: O homem que tem muitos amigos, tem-nos para a sua ruína; mas há um amigo que é mais chegado do que um irmão.
verses.en_web: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
verses.en_bbe: There are friends who may be a man's destruction, but there is a lover who keeps nearer than a brother.
